landed_identity_primitives.extension_rule: reuse or add an adjacent explicit profile
do not silently alter existing payloads or CID profile

landed_identity_primitives.surface: semantic-index stable symbol and version identity
landed_identity_primitives.extension_rule: adapt existing symbol identity rather than create a parallel symbol authority
kit verifies/persists caller-authoritative identities; SAWM adds missing immutable model/profile bindings
consumer bridge only; must not redefine datasets semantic identity

identities.name: source_cid
identities.required_distinction: exact source bytes and codec/profile

identities.name: domain_state_cid
identities.required_distinction: domain-specific state, separate from projection and operational root

identities.name: semantic_object_cid
identities.required_distinction: canonical declaration without model-dependent vector material

identities.name: canonical_program_graph_cid
identities.required_distinction: canonical logical program meaning, not an ANN graph

identities.name: program_graph_snapshot_cid
identities.required_distinction: canonical ordered node/edge set at sealed bindings

identities.name: program_graph_delta_cid
identities.required_distinction: pure change record retaining unchanged subroots

identities.name: raw_execution_state_cid
identities.required_distinction: bounded redacted observed state under exact capture profile

identities.name: abstract_execution_state_cid
identities.required_distinction: semantic abstraction including abstraction_profile_cid and unavailable dimensions

identities.name: stack_frame_cid
identities.required_distinction: one ordered frame with exact code/environment and bounded state summary

identities.name: program_event_cid
identities.required_distinction: closed event grammar record, observation status explicit

identities.name: execution_trace_cid
identities.required_distinction: ordered event/segment identity; repeated states do not erase history

identities.name: projection_cid
identities.required_distinction: model/tokenizer/preprocessor/normalizer/metric/dimension/dtype/byte-order/quantization/vector bindings

identities.name: projection_index_manifest_cid
identities.required_distinction: immutable description of rebuildable non-authoritative index generation

identities.name: relation_claim_cid
identities.required_distinction: typed scope/assumption/policy/environment/evidence/invalidator/authority claim; not similarity

identities.name: proof_obligation_cid
identities.required_distinction: solver-neutral finite obligation and exact premise/environment bindings

identities.name: proof_or_countermodel_cid
identities.required_distinction: candidate versus natively reconstructed/replayed admitted evidence

identities.name: procedure_cid
identities.required_distinction: versioned preconditions/effects/validation/rollback/holes and current authority

identities.name: procedure_certificate_cid
identities.required_distinction: independent held-out/adversarial promotion evidence; never self-certified

identities.name: transition_query_cid
identities.required_distinction: named unresolved decision and exact evidence/current bindings

identities.name: transition_prediction_cid
identities.required_distinction: proposal-only closed structured output plus model/calibration/evidence

identities.name: transition_observation_cid
identities.required_distinction: observed execution truth, never simulation or prediction

identities.name: transition_admission_cid
identities.required_distinction: independent policy/proof/test/freshness/environment admission decision

identities.name: transition_cid
identities.required_distinction: accepted immutable operational transition, separate from proposal and observation

identities.name: world_snapshot_cid
identities.required_distinction: immutable transitive manifest of admitted program-world state

identities.name: world_root_cid
identities.required_distinction: generation-bearing CAS pointer to transitively verified immutable snapshot

identities.name: model_cid
identities.required_distinction: exact admitted model artifact; model name is insufficient

identities.name: tokenizer_cid
identities.required_distinction: exact tokenizer artifact/config identity

identities.name: preprocessing_profile_cid
identities.required_distinction: versioned deterministic preprocessing, separate from semantic object

identities.name: environment_binding_cid
identities.required_distinction: dependency/toolchain/capability state relevant to validity and reuse

identities.name: policy_cid
identities.required_distinction: exact policy revision and authority, separate from model recommendation

compatibility_requirements: model/profile changes affect projection identity only
observation timestamp does not affect semantic identity
raw and abstract identities are distinct
abstraction profile change affects abstract identity
limitations: bootstrap_status is an inventory classification, not an acceptance result
no concrete SAWM CID is asserted by this inventory
missing identities must be implemented as versioned contracts under the named owner
